healthPrivacy: Logged food is written as nutrition — calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber and sodium — from 30 days before sync was turned on. Weight and height sync both ways. Recorded body fat is exported on both platforms; waist circumference is also exported to Apple Health. Other tape measurements and calculated estimates stay in the app. On iPhone, your birthday and sex are read to fill in a new program.

syncSchedule: Syncs daily when allowed by your device, and when you open the app if overdue. Background timing depends on system settings. Food is written a few seconds after you log it.

healthDisclaimer: For general tracking, not diagnosis or treatment. Consult a healthcare professional before making medical decisions. Adult references do not apply to children; individual needs vary.

bmiMethod: BMI = weight (kg) ÷ height (m)². This app uses trend weight. CDC categories apply to adults 20 and older: below 18.5, 18.5–<25, 25–<30, and 30 or above.
bodyFatMethod: A recorded body-fat percentage takes priority. Otherwise, the Navy circumference estimate uses measurements in inches. The equations are documented in AR 600–9 (2019), Appendix B, Table B–5. The app combines the ACE fitness and average categories as “Typical”; these are general comparisons, not personal targets.
ffmiMethod: FFMI = BMI × (1 − body fat % ÷ 100), using trend weight. Schutz et al. (2002) studied white adults aged 18–98. The app’s simplified comparison bands (male 17–20; female 14–17) are not age-specific clinical cutoffs or recommended targets.
ratioMethod: Shoulder circumference ÷ waist circumference. The app’s 1.62 goal is a physique comparison chosen by the app, not a medically validated health target.

noEstimateHelp: Mark days complete and weigh in regularly. The estimate starts once three weeks hold 12 usable days and six weigh-ins, or from your program’s starting estimate.
expenditureExplainerMethod: Each day looks back 21 days. Complete and fasting days, in runs of at least seven, are matched to the change in your weight trend at 7,700 kcal per kg: what you ate minus the energy that went into or came out of storage. Day-to-day values are smoothed.
expenditureExplainerHolding: Without enough new evidence the estimate holds. The shaded range narrows with more usable days and steadier weigh-ins. Check-ins use the same evidence but move more slowly, so their numbers can differ a little. It is an estimate, not a measurement.
weightTrendExplainerScale: Scale weight moves day to day with water, salt, carbs and digestion. Trend weight averages each day’s readings and smooths them with a seven-day half-life, so it shows where your weight is really heading.
weightTrendExplainerUse: Check-ins and the expenditure estimate use the trend. Ignored readings stay in your history but are left out.

coachingProgramTitle: A program built around your goal
coachingProgramBody: Choose Cut, Bulk or Maintain, your goal weight and pace. Age, height, weight, the selected sex equation and activity provide a provisional starting estimate. Protein and diet preferences determine your macros. Manual targets remain available.
coachingWeightBody: Coaching and Progress use the same recent-weighted trend with a seven-day half-life. Same-day readings are averaged. The trend reduces the influence of individual scale fluctuations. It is an estimate, not a measurement of body fat.
coachingIntakeBody: Method 2 examines the previous 21 calendar days. It uses complete contiguous blocks of at least seven days, matching calories and weight changes over those dates. Twelve covered days and six weigh-in days are needed. Small gaps can leave enough usable blocks; missing intake is never assumed to be zero. Explicit fasting counts as zero. Long gaps pause learning without erasing the last estimate.
coachingAdjustBody: Estimated expenditure uses reported calories and changes in normalized weight, with a short-term 7,700 kcal/kg approximation. New evidence is damped toward the previous reviewed estimate. Suggested weekly calorie changes are limited to 150 kcal or 7.5%, whichever is smaller. This is our own approximate method, not MacroFactor’s proprietary model or a clinically validated prediction.
coachingMacrosBody: Protein follows normalized body weight and your chosen grams per kg. Remaining calories go to carbs and fat according to your preference, with a 0.6 g/kg fat floor. Changes are based on actual intake, not whether you hit your old targets.
coachingMaintainBody: Maintenance aims for your selected weight with a 0.7 kg band. Outside that band, a gentle 0.15% weekly correction nudges the plan toward your goal. A cut or bulk that reaches its goal stops requesting further loss or gain. Switch to Maintain to hold that weight.
coachingReviewBody: Check-ins follow your chosen weekday. Review the generated plan and accept or keep your current targets. Accepted changes start today and preserve earlier days. Editing a goal keeps food, weight and learned expenditure history.
coachingScopeBody: Coaching is for adults 18+ who are not pregnant or breastfeeding. Medical nutrition needs and eating disorder care require professional guidance. Targets outside 1,500–5,000 kcal/day, implausible expenditure, rapid changes or sharp weight jumps hold adjustments. These product limits are not individualized safety thresholds.
coachingOlderBody: Plans created before guided program setup keep method 1 until you choose Build my program. Earlier check-ins retain the method that produced them.
